_comment: lint-gate.sh config for ign-lint (bw-design-group/ignition-lint). Errors fail the gate; warnings print only; NamePatternRule findings and pylint W and C messages are style and fail unless baselined. The gate fills in PylintScriptRule's pylintrc.
_PollingIntervalRule: A 1 s clock is fine; faster than that re-evaluates for nothing.
_NamePatternRule: Components PascalCase; properties, custom methods and message handlers camelCase. Its 'property' node is every prop and nested key, so baseline.py keeps only direct children of custom and params. Abbreviation detection is off: it rewrites 'click' as 'CLIck' and then fails it.
_ComponentReferenceValidationRule: ign-lint reads ../../X as a sibling named '..'. Perspective resolves ../../X and .../X alike (checked on 8.3.8), so write the .../X form.
